messages:
ara: Quick sync — we need a concise, exportable span naming & attribute set for LLM requests. Current pile is messy across services. Want something that supports routing, retention, and low-cardinality metrics. Thoughts?
sam: +1. main goals? low-card cards for metric aggregation, high-card for debug only, and privacy for prompt text.
maria: For span.name I'd keep it simple: `llm.request` with `redwood.llm.operation` attr (e.g., generation|embeddings|rerank). Avoid model names in span.name itself.
kevin: Agree. Name should be generic, attributes carry specifics. Proposed attribute list (first pass):
- `redwood.llm.operation` -> generation|chat|embed|rerank
- `redwood.llm.model_id` -> `gpt-4-x`, etc (cardinality = medium)
- `redwood.llm.model_variant` -> `quant8`/`fp16` (medium)
- `redwood.llm.input_tokens` -> int, `redwood.llm.output_tokens` -> int
- `redwood.llm.kv_cache.hit` -> bool, `redwood.llm.kv_cache.size_bytes` -> int
- `redwood.llm.routing.tier` -> hosted|dedicated|private (low)
- `redwood.llm.routing.reason` -> fallback/capacity/cost (high)
- `redwood.llm.prompt_hash` -> hashed_id (low-cardint), no raw prompt
kevin: Also `redwood.llm.quota_bucket` for quota calc & alerting.
ara: Nice. A couple considerations: exporters need to drop high-card attrs before long-term retention; `routing.reason` can explode. We should add an exporter hint attr `redwood.telemetry.export_ttl` with values like `72h|7d|90d`.
jyoti: +1 on export_ttl. Also suggest `redwood.telemetry.sampling_hint` -> low|high|debug. CI/ops can flip sampling for slow requests.
ci-bot: deploy-note: telemetry schema v2 will be rolled to staging tomorrow. See internal doc: https://confluence/repo/llm-telemetry-v2
maria: On attribute naming, prefer dots `redwood.llm.` prefix to avoid colliding with OTEL core. Keep type hints in docs.
sam: Regarding prompt_hash -- what algo? We should standardize to SHA256 hex trimmed to 12 chars to keep cardinality low. Document it so logs & analytics teams align.
kevin: For retention policies: default path -> `operation=embed` TTL 90d, `generation` 30d, `rerank` 14d. Exporter uses `redwood.telemetry.export_ttl` override when set.
ara: Edge case: small model variants will have many unique `model_id`s (community forks). We should map model_id to `redwood.llm.model_family` (e.g., gpt4, llama2) for low-card metrics. Add both attributes, family required.
jyoti: Add `redwood.llm.input_sequence_len` and `redwood.llm.max_context` for capacity planning.
maria: Security note: never include raw prompt or user PII. If teams need raw prompts, pipeline must move them to secured logs with separate access and different hash.
sam: Example span example to standardize in code:```json
span.name: "llm.request"
attributes: {
  "redwood.llm.operation": "generation",
  "redwood.llm.model_family": "gpt4",
  "redwood.llm.model_id": "gpt-4-x-1",
  "redwood.llm.input_tokens": 48,
  "redwood.llm.output_tokens": 120,
  "redwood.llm.kv_cache.hit": true,
  "redwood.llm.routing.tier": "dedicated",
  "redwood.telemetry.export_ttl": "30d",
  "redwood.telemetry.sampling_hint": "low",
  "redwood.llm.prompt_hash": "3f7a1b2c9d4e"
}
```
ara: This is great — next steps: 1) finalize attr list and cardinality labels, 2) add exporter rule prototypes (regex for model families -> TTL), 3) update SDK instrumentation doc. I'll create a short RFC tomorrow. Thanks all :thumbsup:
